$comment: FIT-10 export-consumer allowlist — a started resource may call exports['<res>'] only when <res> is also started (resolved from server.cfg / server.cfg.template) or is an external dependency that intentionally lives outside this repo. Entries are validated by tests/architecture/test_resource_wiring.py: every field is required, expires is a hard date, and an entry that no longer matches any consumer fails as stale. Do not use this file to hide a missing resource: start it or register the real dependency here.

external_dependencies.reason: qb-ambulancejob / qb-hud / qb-vehicleshop 的既有车载油量兼容调用；LegacyFuel 是外部资源，不在本仓库也不在启动链中，替换为 qb-fuel 前保留。
qb-clothing 的旧 jobs 表读取桥接；qb-jobs 未随精简启动链加载，属于外部兼容依赖。
custom-vehicles 与 qb-core 的车辆钥匙兼容调用；本仓库不包含 qb-vehiclekeys，钥匙逻辑由 custom-vehicles 的兼容层兜底。

custom-agent-ops 在 resources/ 里但不在精简启动链 server.cfg 中，只在 configs/modules/dev.cfg（开发/测试环境）里 ensure。custom-director 的 police_run_e2e L1 工具调用它的 RunTest 导出，资源未启动时该调用在 pcall 里失败并返回 execution_failed，不影响正常游戏流程。需要跑 E2E 时先 exec dev.cfg。
qb-houses 存在于 resources/ 但不在精简启动链里（check_dependencies.DEFERRED_RESOURCES）；qb-garages 只在车库类型为 house 时调用它的 hasKey 导出，属于休眠分支。真正启用房屋系统时先从启动链移除本例外。
